name: docs-vault
description: Skills for keeping a project's docs/ folder as an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: docs-vault
plugins.description: Keeps a project's docs/ Obsidian vault behind one agent, the vault-keeper, so the main conversation's context stays free: Claude sends it JSON requests to look things up or record work, checked by hooks against a contract. The vault keeps notes on what is true now, a curated daily journal with plain follow-up checkboxes, and a Decisions folder for why, and leaves everything else to the project's Conventions.md. Commands: init, ask, record, todos, lint, graph and preset. Requires kepano/obsidian-skills.
